reasons.plausibility: Aluminum has very limited solubility in BCC refractory alloys and tends to form intermetallics, making a single-phase BCC solid solution with 25–30% Al substitution highly unlikely and contradicting established phase equilibria.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific alloy compositions, characterization methods, and quantitative rejection criteria for both strength and ductility.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically unsound premise (high Al solubility in BCC HfMoTaTiZr) that would not guide a researcher toward a viable experiment.
